fact: As of 14 July 2020 the World Bank's LIRE project (P168779, US$140 million, approved 6 April 2020, closing 30 April 2026, implemented by the ministries of primary and secondary education) funds modernising the education information and management system under a US$36 million component, and its indicator 'Annual school census conducted through new digital tools' stood at No against a target of Yes by August 2026.
title: Implementation Status & Results Report: Niger Learning Improvement for Results in Education Project (P168779), Seq No: 1
